💡Building Collective Impact Across the City of London Corporation  

Last week, I attended the 2026 Summer Soiree, which was more than just a networking event, it was a clear demonstration of the power of intentional community-building across industries.

Hosted by Square Mile and CBERG - City Black ERGs, in partnership with Wellington Management Shades, Macquarie Group BEAM and the Black Excellence Network UK, the event created space for authentic connection, collaboration and celebration, there were no panels, no formal agenda, just meaningful conversations that matter.

The concept of the event began last year as an informal gathering of Black professionals in a pub and has evolved this year with hundreds of professionals, executives, founders, creatives and community leaders coming together in the heart of the City of London across finance, tech, media, law and the creative industries.

In a time where many organisations are navigating uncertainty around inclusion, representation and community investment, spaces like this matter deeply. 

Spsces like this remind us that progress does not happen in silos and real impact happens when communities collaborate across sectors, share resources, exchange opportunities and collectively open doors for the next generation.

If this is how far the community has come in just one year, I’m excited to see what can be achieved as we continue to collaborate, scale and build collectively.

Well done Savannah Adams and all those involved
